title: Collapse navigation buttons into a dropdown menu

requirements.summary: Replace flat navigation buttons with a dropdown menu containing all eight tabs (Dashboard, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time), preserving the admin-only Verification tab visibility logic
acceptanceCriteria: A single dropdown trigger button is visible in place of the individual navigation buttons.
Opening the dropdown reveals all eight items: Dashboard, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time.
Clicking any dropdown item switches the active tab to the corresponding section.
The dropdown closes automatically after a selection is made.
The currently active section is visually highlighted in the dropdown list.
The dropdown is keyboard-accessible (open/close with Enter/Escape, navigate with arrow keys).

file_operations.description: Replace the flat row of navigation buttons with a dropdown menu component. Import and use shadcn/ui DropdownMenu components (DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem) to create a single trigger button that opens a menu listing all eight navigation items (Dashboard, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time). Wire each DropdownMenuItem's onClick to call setActiveTab with the corresponding tab value. Apply visual highlighting to the currently active tab item within the dropdown (e.g., using a checkmark icon or background color). Ensure the Verification tab remains conditionally rendered for admins only and is not included in the dropdown. Preserve all existing tab content rendering logic and state management. The dropdown must close automatically after a selection is made and support keyboard navigation (Enter/Escape to open/close, arrow keys to navigate items).
